p.s: Travel is important, and everyone like to travel and enjoy his/her life due to that it is normally in the person to like travel and relaxed.

There are many reasons and examples why it is more useful to travel in this way.
First, the travel in group make the journey or trip more enjoyable and active.
For example, if you travel alone you will not get that enjoy which you can get in a small atittude such as male with a group.
In addition if you get any problems, you will find someone can help you.

If you travel with a guide, you will go to the best place, the more comfortable or the more enjoyable.
In addition you will not get any terrible or any harsh time since that it has already someone visited or known more about the place that you would vistit.
On the other hand, if you travel alone, you might only spend time to find nice place just to spent the night in it.
Third, travel with a guide will help you to learn more about the place which you visit especially if your guide was a scinetist or someone has a long experience with place he/she will visit.
In addition, if you visit a natural place, and you could get information about it from your guide, and you will teach your family and friends about that place, plus getting a outstanding experience.
In the end, there are many reasons why it is better to travel in a group led by a guide than to travel alone.
Some of them I have already mentiond, and some of them you can figure them out.
Because of that try to travel in a group which led by a leader as much as you can.
